# Contributing to Gush AI E-commerce Chatbot

We welcome contributions to the Gush AI E-commerce Chatbot plugin! Here's how you can help:

## Reporting Issues

- Check existing issues before opening new ones
- Include detailed steps to reproduce
- Provide your WordPress and plugin versions
